issue: Must a sentence under 18 U.S.C. § 924(j) for discharging a firearm during a crime of violence resulting in death run consecutively to the sentences on the other counts, or may the court impose it concurrently?

sides.position: Section 924(j) mandates a consecutive sentence relative to the other counts (the view the district court followed).
cases: United States v. Wallace, 772 F. App'x 320 (6th Cir. 2019)
Wallace v. United States, 43 F.4th 595 (6th Cir. 2022)

quote: A circuit conflict existed over whether a sentence under § 924(j) must run consecutively with the sentences for the other counts.
cite: Dominique Wallace v. United States, 43 F.4th 595 (6th Cir. 2022)
